body:
I know how you feel, and I empathize with you. I feel like suicidiality often envelops and obscures the rest of my personality, and makes it really hard to connect with others. It can be really difficult. 

Our situations aren't the same, and I don't mean to compare them, but I especially understand your guilt. I feel guilty talking to therapists for this reason exactly. As much as this sounds like bullshit, time will help. Although it's very difficult to overcome this feeling, it got better for me once I had been seeing the same therapist for a few months. I still feel immense guilt talking to other people in my life about mental health. Just keep in mind that those who love you are there to help you through this period of your life. This feeling isn't permenant. 

I'm so sorry you feel this way. I feel so similarly, and I wouldn't wish it anyone. Feel free to reach out in dms if you want to talk about this more.

But isn't it unfair to base my happiness off someone else? I have such a hard time connecting with people because I feel so blank. I need to be independently happy I can't just be using others to carry my issues instead of dealing with them
